entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.1067 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C-IV (Cog. Taking), Cuttack arising out Madhupatna P.S.
Case No.234 of 2022 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 341/420/506 IPC.

2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.
3.
Mr. Bose, learned counsel for the Informant, submits that he has already filed the Vakalatanama on behalf of the Informant.
Registry is called upon to trace the same and tag with the record.
Name of Mr. Bose be reflected in the brief as well as in the cause list.
4. Learned counsels for the Petitioner as well as the Informant, on instruction, submits that they are agreeable to settle the matter through ADR by way of Mediation.
5. Accordingly, learned Coordinator, Orissa High Court Mediation Centre at Cuttack is called upon to appoint the Mediator.

entities.text: Orissa High Court Mediation Centre at Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Informant, Mr. Bose that the Informant serves as a Captain in Merchant Navy.

Hence, his authorized representative may be permitted to take part in Basanta Kumar Bal vs State Of Odisha on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152214710/
1 the mediation.
7.

entities.text: Basanta Kumar Bal vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the peculiar facts of the present case, learned Mediator shall not insist on the physical presence of the Informant.
Before final decision is taken written consent of the Informant shall be placed before the learned Mediator.
To avoid any unnecessary delay both the sides are requested to appear before the learned Mediator on 22.04.2025 for settlement of the issues inter se between the parties.

8. List this matter on 13.05.2025 along with the report of the learned Mediator.
9.
Registry is requested to do the needful in placing the matter before the learned Coordinator Mediation Centre for necessary follow up action.
10. Since the matter has been referred to for mediation, interim order passed earlier shall continue till the next date.

(V. Narasingh)
 PKS Judge Signed by: PRADEEP KUMAR SWAIN
